:star: **.shop** - Shows all avaliable items from the Shop
:star: **.buy :emoji: (or .buy (number in shop))** - Purchases an avaliable item from the Shop
:star: **.sell :emoji:** - Sells an item you own back to the Shop for 80% back, if it is not in the current Shop you only get 800 Gems
:star: **.trade @user (item you own) (gems you want for it) ``.t``** - Trade items with users - type for more info

:star: **.sell :emoji:** - Sells an item you own back to the Shop for 80% back, if it is not in the current Shop you only get 800 Gems
:star: **.trade @user (item you own) (gems you want for it) ``.t``** - Trade items with users - type for more info
